title: krmn K4: pre-Commit checks, proposal checks on receipt, refuse invalid existing leaves (rule 3)
description: mls-extensions #110 rule 3. Proposal and UpdatePath LeafNodes checked against the pre-Commit GroupContext (decision .4.49 post-Commit superseded for these; K3 keeps the post-Commit all-members check); standalone Add/Update proposals checked on receipt (member.rs:1155-1171, observer.rs:516-521, 568-575); existing tree leaves failing the GroupContext lists are REFUSED at join_welcome, join_external and Observer::from_group_info (decision .4.57 superseded; hub currently discards the report at hub/mod.rs:291, :528). Regression tests first. See krmn design.
